messages:
Maya: Heads-up — I'm opening a docs PR to reorganize the console observability examples. Moving tracing-hook snippets into /examples/console and standardizing Node/Rust variants. Found ~4 broken cross-links from the dashboard heatmap and cost breakdown pages, and one outdated param in the trace snippet. Can anyone help quick-review?
Sam: ack, I can take the trace snippet. paste the failing links?
Maya: Links: https://docs.redwood.ai/console/heatmap -> 404, https://docs.redwood.ai/console/tracing-hook -> redirect loop, https://docs.redwood.ai/console/costs#breakdown -> anchors changed. Also the Node trace example uses `traceKey` which our SDK deprecated last month.
Sam: got it. quick patch for Node example — replace the old call with the new traceHook helper so prefix/KV semantics are correct.
Sam: ```js
// old
client.trace({ traceKey: 'abc', payload })

// new
client.traceHook({ trace_context: ctx, event: payload })
```
Jordan: I can handle dashboard-side anchor updates — looks like the heatmap anchor moved from `#heatmap-overview` -> `#heatmap-ux`. I'll add a redirect and update the inline link. Also will rename `latency_pct` to `latency_p50` in the presets; callout added in PR.
Li: FYI on cost numbers — the cost/latency matrix in the doc needs updated units. per-token -> per-1k tokens. Use these figures for the example: hosted small: $0.012 / 1k, hosted medium: $0.035 / 1k, dedicated baseline: $0.021 / 1k.
Maya: thanks Li — can you drop that table as markdown in the PR? I'll wire it into the cost block.
docs-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/724 — Maya -> branch: docs/snippet-polish/tracehook-migration. CI pending.
Harper: I can run smoke checks and a local preview of the console pages after the link fixes. Throw the branch to me when ready.
Sam: pushed the Node snippet update and added a brief note about `traceKey` deprecation. Also added a tiny Rust example to mirror the node helper and show `trace_context` usage.
Maya: pushed the markdown cost table and updated the example path references. PTAL, @Harper @Jordan @Sam.
Harper: previewed locally — heatmap renders, anchors resolved, code blocks highlight fine. No visual regressions. :thumbsup:
Jordan: updated the dashboard presets PR to include `latency_p50` migration note and added a changelog entry under docs/changes.md.
Maya: awesome, thanks all. I'll wait for CI and then merge. If anything else pops up, leave comments on PR 724.
Sam: small follow-up: we should add a short migration note in the SDK changelog too, call out `traceKey` -> `traceHook`. I'll open a tiny PR there.
Maya: perfect — marking this thread done once PR is merged.
